regions.today: A bright day with sunny spells and scattered showers. Highest temperatures of 17 to 21 degrees with moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry tonight with clear spells and just isolated showers. It will become cloudier in the west of the province towards morning. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 9 degrees in a light southwesterly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Saturday, will be dry with sunny spells, turning hazier in the afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 19 to 22 degrees in a light to moderate westerly breeze.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Friday and Saturday.
